Definition: from G1388; to ensnare, i.e. (figuratively) adulterate:--handle deceitfully.
BiblicalUsage: To handle deceitfully, as Paul says he has renounced the hidden things of dishonesty and does not handle the word of God deceitfully.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the word of God must be handled straight, because a crooked handling of a straight word still leads people crooked.
